C-GATE-SURFACE.Summary: Create the third check surface — invocable transition gates that declare required evidence, record their decisions, and refuse approve/apply/archive (and further attempts on escalated tasks) without re-deriving what status and the cursor already know.
C-GATE-SURFACE.Problem:
The pipeline is [LLM generates artifact] → [deterministic verifier] → [policy gate] → [execute/apply]. Box 3 does not exist. Transitions are authored acts: ngrace-execute rules 8–9 set status to applied and archive the bundle with no gate; plan approval is the same shape in ngrace-plan/ngrace-spec. A17.2 measured that a correct continuous non-blocking signal (needs-plan on ngrace status) was walked past for four review rounds — so a gate that only advises is no gate.
§5.3 assumed transition commands inside src/grace.ts. At 6389e3a that file registers eight subcommands (cursor, doctor, file, graph, lint, module, status, verification) and none approves, applies, or archives (A29.2). Wiring into a host that does not exist is not a design question.
D11 requires a recorded review verdict before applied. KNOWN_KIND_STATE (grace-cursor.ts:178-187) is exhaustive over kind→state with no verdict kind, and no write path produces one (A29.3). Phase 6 will produce verdict content; without a record and validator, Phase 5 cannot implement the apply requirement, and sequencing rule 3 puts 5 before 6 for that reason.
D12 requires typed clarifications as absence. [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] exists nowhere under src/ or skills/. ASSUMPTION exists only as optional template markup. Without a schema element and validator, the approve gate's only §5.4 requirement is vacuous (A29.4).
D11 says the project declares whether a missing verdict is fatal. --fail-on exists only as a per-command flag on lint and status; .ngrace-lint.json admits five keys and no fail-on (lint/config.ts:7-13) (A29.5). host-capability-missing is named in decisions and absent from the binary (A29.6).
A27.3 hands three concrete obligations: refuse applied without a plan (A17.2), refuse archive with an open epoch (A10.10 §1), refuse further attempts on an escalated task (A21.1 / A22.3) reading escalatedTasks (grace-cursor.ts:137).

Goals.Goal: An invocable gate surface: ngrace gate <approve|apply|archive> --change C-X, registered from src/grace.ts, implemented under src/gates/. Structured report a caller can act on without parsing prose (A29.2, conclusion 1).

Each gate declares required evidence. Required absence fails closed; optional absence is reported and does not block; present evidence is consulted (D5 gate half). Blocking is never a property of a mechanism (anti-pattern 9).

Gate decisions are recorded as durable ledger events (gate-decision). A bundle that reached applied or archive without a matching record is a status/gate finding, never a gate.* code from runLint (D14, A29.9, A17.2 family).

Review-verdict ledger event and validator ship in this change; Phase 6 produces content. NON_POSITION_KINDS (or equivalent) so a verdict does not move cursor state — discriminating negative: verdict after terminal leaves state complete (A29.3, conclusion 2, invariant 4).
Typed Clarification element with target anchor under change-spec and change-plan grammar, with validator; skills and templates teach it. Never a prose marker (A29.4, conclusion 3, anti-pattern 3).
Project-level gateFailOn (or named equivalent) on .ngrace-lint.json; apply consults it for missing verdict / host-capability-missing (A29.5, conclusion 4, D11).

apply refuses without a plan, consuming needs-plan inputs from status rather than re-deriving (A17.2, standing rule 1). archive refuses open epoch via listLooseEvents (A10.10 §1). cursor attempt refuses when task is in escalatedTasks via gate evaluation (A21.1 / A22.3).
apply permits unable-to-determine and refuses no verdict — the D11 discriminating pair. ASSUMPTION blocks nothing anywhere (D12).
D14 boundary: gate.* never emitted by runLint; integration test present (A29.7).
Skill text places the gate call before the authored transition in ngrace-execute, ngrace-plan, ngrace-spec; narrow note in ngrace-reviewer; packaged mirrors byte-identical.

Constraints.Constraint: No production transition commands that author status=applied or move bundles. Gate evaluates and records; the agent authors the lifecycle write (invariant 8 / F1, A29.2).
src/lint/core.ts does not learn about gates. gate.* codes live in src/gates/catalog.ts (D14).
Consume needs-plan (grace-status.ts:199) and escalatedTasks / listUnresolvedEscalatedTasks; do not fork second derivations (standing rules 1 and 9, A29.10).
No second absence vocabulary. Reuse AbsenceValue; host-capability-missing is a named reason, not a parallel enum (A29.6, anti-pattern 5).
Clarifications are schema elements with validators in the same change (invariant 4). No regex over prose (anti-pattern 3).
Drop-site inventory before widening KNOWN_KIND_STATE or adding NON_POSITION_KINDS (A5.4, A29.3).
Additive only. Projects without gates, verdicts, or clarifications keep validating where those constructs are absent (invariant 5) — except transitions that this change newly refuses.
No new runtime dependencies. No Phase 6+ constructs: no detached reviewer automation, no confidence field, no plan-quality signal.
skills/ngrace/* is source of truth; plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/* stays byte-identical in the same commit (invariant 1, §12.2).
AffectedAreas derives from the traced code path and A29.18, never from §5.3's provisional table alone (A5.6).
Every AC descending from an A29 correction cites it inline (A5.6).
Tests use fixture bundles only; no dependence on transient live artifact state (A6.4).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Detached reviewer and mechanized audits that produce verdict content (Phase 6). This change ships the record and validator only (conclusion 2).
Deterministic failure localization (Phase 7), selection (Phase 8), confidence/calibration (Phase 9), plan-quality/doctor consumers (Phase 10), adoption walkthrough (Phase 11).
CLI commands that set status=applied or archive a bundle directory.
Making lint depend on run state or emit gate.* codes (D14).
Treating ASSUMPTION as absence or as a gate requirement (D12).
Replacing or renaming the three Phase 2 absence issue codes.
The file-to-module ObservedWriteScope cross-check (A5.7; still unowned).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-GATE-OWN-SURFACE: Correction 49 (A29.2). ngrace gate approve|apply|archive --change C-X is registered from src/grace.ts and implemented under src/gates/. It evaluates and records; it does not write status attributes or move bundle directories. Discriminating negative: no new subcommand named approve, apply, or archive at the top level that mutates lifecycle status.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-GATE-D14-BOUNDARY: A gate.* code is never present in runLint output. Integration test: project with open epoch and absent review verdict yields zero gate.* codes from ngrace lint (A29.7, D14). Both directions per A7.2: gate evaluation still emits gate.* on its own surface.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-GATE-DECISION-RECORDED: Correction 56 (A29.9). Every evaluation appends a durable gate-decision event (ledger∪loose). Report shape exposes gate, decision, and per-requirement results without requiring prose parse. Status (or gate) surfaces applied/archive without a matching record; lint does not.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-VERDICT-RECORD: Correction 50 (A29.3, conclusion 2). review-verdict event can be written with outcomes including unable-to-determine and host-capability-missing; fold preserves payload; validator makes the grammar load-bearing (invariant 4). Discriminating negative: a review-verdict after terminal leaves cursor state complete (NON_POSITION_KINDS inventory, A5.4). Phase 6 content production is out of scope.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-TYPED-CLARIFICATION: Correction 51 (A29.4, conclusion 3). Clarification is a schema element with target= anchor under change-spec and change-plan; invalid targets error; unresolved clarifications on IC-* or INV-* refuse approve. [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] prose is not a detection path. Templates and ngrace-spec / ngrace-plan teach the element. Without this AC the approve gate is vacuous.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-APPROVE-GATE: Clarification on IC-* or INV-* refuses approve; ASSUMPTION anywhere does not; clarification on a non-satisfied AC-* does not block approve (D12, A29.12). Three tests minimum.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-APPLY-VERDICT: Apply refuses with no verdict event; apply permits with unable-to-determine (D11 discriminating pair, §5.7 gate 3). host-capability-missing under project permissive vs strict gateFailOn both shown (A29.5, A29.6).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-APPLY-NEEDS-PLAN: Correction A17.2 / A29.10. Apply refuses when the bundle has no plan, consuming the same inputs status uses for needs-plan (grace-status.ts:199) rather than a forked rule. Retires A17.3's manual discipline once this gate ships.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-OPEN-EPOCH: A10.10 §1 / A29.10. Archive refuses when listLooseEvents is non-empty; permits after fold empties run/. Escalated unfoldable epoch remains refused (A18.5 §1 caller).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ESCALATED-ATTEMPT: A21.1 / A22.3 / A29.10. cursor attempt on a task in escalatedTasks refuses via gate evaluation; after resolving resume, attempts proceed within the A24 window. Policy lives in src/gates/; the mechanism does not invent it (anti-pattern 9).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PROJECT-GATE-FAIL-ON: Correction 52 (A29.5, conclusion 4). Project declaration on .ngrace-lint.json; SUPPORTED_KEYS updated; apply reads it for missing-verdict severity. A per-invocation flag alone does not satisfy this AC.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ASSUMPTION-NEVER-BLOCKS: An Assumption element on a fixture bundle never causes approve or apply to refuse (D12, A29.12).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SKILL-GATE-CALL: ngrace-execute places ngrace gate apply/archive before rules 8–9 transitions; ngrace-plan places ngrace gate approve before setting plan approved; ngrace-spec/plan templates carry Clarification; ngrace-reviewer notes verdict record shape. validate:marketplace green; line delta reported (A29.8).

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: bun test src/gates src/grace-cursor.test.ts src/artifact/grammar.test.ts src/lint/core.test.ts src/grace-status.test.ts
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit and integration tests for the three gates, boundary test, non-position verdict, clarifications, project gateFailOn, escalated-attempt refusal; root lint 0 errors with C-GATE-SURFACE present; marketplace mirror check green.

Assumptions.Assumption: Maintainer approves this draft spec before plan.xml is authored; plan is written before any production code (A17.3, grammar.ts:1090-1091).
The four conclusions in A29.15 remain binding for stage 2; a code contradiction during build stops under §12.5 rather than silently redesigning.
Ledger remains the home for verdict and gate-decision events unless the A5.4 inventory at build time contradicts it — in which case stage 2 reports and stops (A29.3).
